hook: Docker on your Mac, with memory handed back.

beats.say: Katamaran is an open-source way to run Docker containers and Linux machines on Apple silicon Macs, all inside one virtual machine.
It pairs a custom Hypervisor framework monitor based on libkrun with a native Swift app and the kat command-line tool.
File sharing uses direct hypercalls, and unused guest memory goes back to macOS in sixty-four kilobyte blocks.
